_note: What the channel guide keeps out of search. Empty lists mean nothing is held: every bundle is indexed and every channel name is printed. Chad cleared all three on 2026-10-13, for the time being. To put a hold back, copy an entry from releasedBrands, releasedBundles or releasedChannels into the matching held list and rebuild. A held bundle still builds, at noindex, and drops out of sitemap.xml and llms.txt; a held channel name disappears from every indexed page, including the JSON-LD, and the channel list ends with a count instead. Counts stay true either way.
